profitability: OUT OF SCOPE AND NOT CLAIMED. Even perfect conversion of the measured residual had insufficient margin in this corpus: the marginal pair is 0.9952 and the whole prize is $0.1563. Improved persistence is NOT expected profit and must not be described as such until filled and settled evidence exists.
safety: would_cross is evaluated BEFORE the modified branch and is never suspended, so holding cannot breach post-only. bbo_unreadable and book_one_sided cancel immediately under both arms.
scope: BOUNDED SHADOW EXPERIMENT. No production change. The arm is not imported by any production module, is in neither the probe image nor the recorder watch set, and nothing here is proposed for deployment.
the_one_changed_behaviour: branch 6 of the live cancel ladder (touch_moved) is suppressed for a COMPLETE whose price is pinned by the pair ceiling AND whose recomputation against the refreshed book returns the same legal maker price. Every other branch, in its live order, is unchanged and still terminates the order.
